jobs.positionDescription: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the design and development of scalable backend services powering our recruitment platform. You will own critical microservices from ideation through production, collaborate closely with product and frontend teams, and establish engineering best practices across the organization. This role offers significant technical influence and the opportunity to shape the architecture of a platform that connects thousands of applicants with employers across the Caribbean.
requirements: 5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience
Strong system design and architecture skills with proven production deployments
Deep knowledge of RESTful API design and microservices patterns
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code
Ability to mentor and review code for junior and mid-level engineers
responsibilities: Architect, build, and operate high-availability microservices handling thousands of concurrent users
Lead technical design reviews and establish coding standards for the backend team
Mentor 2-4 junior engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
Own incident response and post-mortems for backend services; drive reliability improvements
Collaborate with product managers to scope features and define technical specifications
Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and practices to improve team velocity
qualifications: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
AWS Solutions Architect or GCP Professional Cloud certification preferred
Published open-source contributions or technical writing a strong plus

jobs.positionDescription: We are seeking a Frontend Developer to craft responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces for our applicant-facing recruitment platform. You will translate design mockups into pixel-perfect components, optimize core web vitals, and ensure every interaction is smooth for users on varying devices and network conditions across the Caribbean. This is a great opportunity for someone passionate about user experience and modern web standards.
requirements: 3+ years of professional frontend development experience
Strong proficiency in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
Experience building responsive layouts that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop
Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and inclusive design
Comfortable with component-driven development and design systems
responsibilities: Implement and maintain reusable UI component library aligned with our design system
Optimize application performance: lazy loading, code splitting, image optimization, and caching strategies
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests (Vitest, Testing Library) to maintain >80% coverage
Collaborate with UX designers to prototype and iterate on user flows
Participate in frontend guild meetings to share patterns and align on tooling
Monitor and resolve frontend production issues flagged by error tracking (Sentry)
qualifications: BSc in Computer Science, HCI, or related field — or equivalent portfolio of shipped products
Demonstrated knowledge of WCAG accessibility guidelines and assistive technologies
Experience with progressive web apps or offline-first architectures a plus

jobs.positionDescription: We are hiring an HR & Recruitment Specialist to own the full recruitment lifecycle — from sourcing and screening candidates to coordinating interviews, negotiating offers, and ensuring smooth onboarding. You will be the primary point of contact for applicants and hiring managers alike, maintaining a positive candidate experience throughout. This role is central to our mission of connecting Caribbean talent with opportunity and requires someone who is organized, empathetic, and data-driven in their approach to hiring.
requirements: 2+ years of experience in HR generalist or recruitment specialist roles
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for candidate and stakeholder interaction
Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruitment CRM tools
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage 15+ open requisitions simultaneously
Knowledge of Jamaican labor law and employment compliance requirements
responsibilities: Source qualified candidates through job boards, social media, referrals, and community partnerships
Screen resumes and conduct initial phone screens to assess fit and motivation
Coordinate and schedule multi-round interviews with hiring managers and panelists
Extend and negotiate offer letters; manage counter-offers and rejections with professionalism
Lead new-hire onboarding: documentation, orientation scheduling, IT setup coordination, and 30/60/90-day check-ins
Track recruitment KPIs (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, offer acceptance rate) and report monthly to leadership
qualifications: BSc in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or related discipline
SHRM-CP or PHR certification strongly preferred
Bilingual English/Spanish a plus for regional hiring coordination

jobs.positionDescription: We are looking for a Data Analyst to turn our recruitment data into actionable insights that drive hiring strategy and platform improvements. You will build dashboards, run exploratory analyses, design A/B experiments, and present findings to senior leadership. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations — your work will directly influence how we match candidates with jobs and measure the health of our recruitment pipeline.
requirements: 2+ years of professional data analysis or business intelligence experience
Strong SQL skills for complex queries across relational and denormalized data
Proficiency in at least one scripting language for data wrangling (Python or R)
Experience building interactive dashboards and reports for non-technical stakeholders
Solid understanding of statistical concepts: hypothesis testing, regression, confidence intervals
responsibilities: Design and maintain real-time and scheduled dashboards tracking recruitment funnel metrics (applicants per role, drop-off rates, source quality)
Conduct exploratory analyses to identify hiring bottlenecks, candidate quality patterns, and geographic talent clusters
Design and analyze A/B tests for platform features (e.g., job recommendation algorithms, UI changes)
Partner with engineering to define event tracking and ensure data quality across the pipeline
Produce monthly and quarterly insight reports with clear recommendations for the executive team
Develop and document reusable query templates and analysis playbooks for the team
qualifications: BSc in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or related quantitative field
Experience with BI platforms (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or Power BI)
Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools a plus
